anchorRefinement.bboxDefinition: alpha > 128, components >= 8 pixels; half-open pixel bbox center
anchorRefinement.footDiagnostic: Bottom 18% alpha median; diagnostic only, not an anatomical foot guarantee
anchorRefinement.imageShiftDiagnostic: imageShiftWorld is the anchor-only translation at selected PPU; bboxCenterImageShiftWorld includes both raw-to-selected scale and anchor changes. Before footprint diagnostics use raw PPU, after diagnostics use selected PPU.
anchorRefinement.unchanged: PNG pixels, source/meta, frame names/IDs, absolute outline geometry, rect Y/height and pivotY=.01
anchorRefinement.rectPaddingPolicy: Minimum integer X extension within original cell, no rect overlap; added pixels may have alpha 0..8 only and lie outside the unchanged absolute outline. This is not a claim of strictly zero alpha.

calibration.reason: Explicit visual anatomical-size calibration against existing Cless HQ/extra/polish head and boot sizes; crouched total bbox height is not the size reference.

poseAnchorCorrection.supersedes: Old bbox-relative world-X preservation only for cless_18_1; the reviewed body anchor replaces it.
poseAnchorCorrection.unchanged: All v6 PNG pixels, PPU220, 80 IDs/names, rects, pivotY and outline coordinates; 79 entire v6 frame records.
poseAnchorCorrection.limitation: Exact-content transfer of prior actual-capture evidence. This is not a new rendered continuity pass; actual v6 playback must be reviewed.
